overview: The Working Capital Loan Scheme by SIDBI provides collateral-free working capital support to MSMEs through digital platforms like DigiCash and GST Sahay, enabling quick sanction within 48 hours. It is designed to address short-term liquidity needs for raw material purchases, credit sales, and operational expenses. The scheme leverages invoice-based financing and digital public infrastructure for seamless, paperless processing. It targets existing SIDBI customers who are GST and Udyam registered with at least two years of business operations and positive cash accruals.
objectives: To provide cash flow-based financing for purchase of raw materials or credit sales
To enable 'on tap' working capital through invoice-based financing via GST Sahay App
To offer collateral-free credit with quick disbursement and attractive interest rates
To support GST and Udyam registered micro and small enterprises with 2+ years of operations
To facilitate digital, straight-through processing using OCEN and Account Aggregator frameworks
To improve liquidity and cash flow management for MSMEs
To enable financing against purchase or sales invoices with up to 90% of invoice value processed
eligibility: Existing SIDBI customers who are Micro & Small Enterprises with GST and Udyam Registration mandatory, 2 years of business operations, and cash accruals in the last audited financial year.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital financing; quick disbursement; attractive interest rates; digital, straight-through process; end-to-end digital execution; invoice-based financing for purchases (PIBF) or sales (SIBF); up to 100% of purchase invoice value or 90% of sales invoice value processed; direct payment to supplier or customer's bank account; NACH mandate for repayment; use of Digital Public Infrastructure (India Stack) including Aadhaar, UPI, GST, and open API systems.
financial_support: The scheme provides need-based working capital finance with a maximum credit limit of up to ₹50 lakh. For Purchase Invoice Based Financing (PIBF), 100% of the invoice value is processed and paid to the supplier’s bank account. For Sales Invoice Based Financing (SIBF), up to 90% of the invoice value is processed and paid directly to the customer’s bank account. Repayment is made by the customer along with applicable interest on the due date.
application_process: 1. Registration & KYC 2. Sanction & Acceptance of limit/loan 3. Digital Document Execution & NACH mandate 4. Disbursement
required_documents: Proof of 2 years of business operations
Last audited financial statement showing cash accruals
Bank account details for NACH mandate
implementing_agency: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
caveats: Available only to existing SIDBI customers
Minimum 2 years of business operations required
Cash accruals in last audited financial year required
Maximum credit limit capped at ₹50 lakh
For Sales Invoice Based Financing (SIBF), only up to 90% of invoice value is financed
